column2: Identify and highlight my qualities, talents, and key achievements.
Clarify what matters to me and what guides my decisions on a daily basis.
Define what I would like to explore, learn, or experience in the short and medium term.
Understand what makes me want to invest myself in my work and career.
Spot the points on which I want to progress or gain confidence.
List the topics, activities, or fields that naturally attract or excite me.
Identify the people, projects, or experiences that inspire me and fuel my ideas.
Take into account my personal, material, or family constraints when making choices.
Gather feedback and testimonials from others about my skills and qualities.
